title: ScenarioV2
description: BusDiagram scenario, format 2. Generated by `npm run schema`.

$schema.description: Schema path for editor completion; ignored by BusDiagram.

formatVersion.description: Format version: 2, the only supported version.

lines.description: Twisted-pair lines. Multiple lines add line couplers and main lines; multiple areas add a backbone.

clock.description: Simulated clock: local date and time at simulation start, and acceleration. Clock masters, time switches, and time windows use it.

start.description: Local date and time at start, such as 2026-09-28T21:58:00 (no time zone).

speed.description: Clock seconds per simulated second; 60 makes one minute pass per second.

rooms.description: Rooms: thermal state shared by assigned thermostats, window contacts, and radiators.

topology.description: Topology levels and coupler settings. Without this field, a main line appears with two lines in an area and a backbone with two areas.

backbone.description: Backbone line 0.0 and area couplers A.0.0, even with one area.

mainLines.description: Area main lines A.0 and line couplers A.L.0, even with one line.

ip.description: IP network: KNXnet/IP routers replace area couplers (areaCouplers, A.0.0) or line couplers (lineCouplers, A.L.0). Devices with medium IP connect to it.

name.description: Area name displayed in the diagram, for example “Building A”.

couplers.description: Group-telegram routing settings for couplers and routers; filtering is the default.

address.description: Coupler address: A.L.0 for a line or A.0.0 for an area.

down.description: Primary-to-secondary direction: filter by association table, route everything, or block everything.

up.description: Secondary → primary line: filter, route, or block.

ipRouter.description: Legacy single-router IP network setting; prefer topology.ip. The address must belong to a coupler (A.L.0 or A.0.0).

groupRanges.description: Names of main groups ("1") and middle groups ("1/2"), shown in the group address tree of the designer.

name.description: Name of the group, such as Lighting or Dimming.

groupAddresses.description: Declared group addresses: names and DPTs displayed in the monitor and inherited by associated objects.

devices.description: Devices in cable order on their line; order determines propagation delay.

speed.description: Initial speed (1 = normal simulated time, 0.35 = slower).

filterTables.description: Show coupler filter tables on startup.

dpt.description: Datapoint type: a simulated DPT, or another standard DPT that passive and display devices show without simulating it.

anyOf.description: Standard DPT shown but not simulated (passive/v1 and display/v1 objects only): its value stays unknown or raw.

address.description: Line address in area.line form, such as 1.1; values 1–15. Main lines and backbone come from topology.

name.description: Name displayed under the bus, for example “Example line”.

extension.description: Line extension: repeater or segment coupler to a downstream segment.

address.description: Extension individual address on the line, such as 2.1.64.

mode.description: repeater: forward without filtering; segmentCoupler: use a filter table.

switchable.description: Show a repeater/segment-coupler selector in the toolbar.

powerSupply.description: Power supply of the downstream segment; each segment needs its own.
Bus power supply of the line, shown on the diagram.
KNX power supply with choke. Shown on the diagram; the bus load is not computed.

name.description: Name, such as a product reference.

currentMa.description: Rated current in mA, such as 160, 320, 640, or 1280.

name.description: Purpose shown in the monitor and tooltips.

dpt.description: DPT inherited by objects that do not declare their own.

id.description: ID unique within the device; buttons, inputs, and indicators may refer to it.

name.description: Name shown on the device card; defaults to the ID.

ga.description: Associated group addresses: the first is the sending address; others are receive-only. An empty list leaves the object unassociated.

dpt.description: Object DPT; defaults to the DPT of its first declared group address.

port.description: Object role in the device's behavior.

channel.description: Channel ID within the device; required by actuator ports.

value.description: Initial value (zero by default; unknown for a display port).

flags.description: Flags: C communication, R read, W write, T transmit, U update, I read on initialisation.

W.description: Accept a received GroupValueWrite; otherwise the telegram is ignored and the value stays unchanged.

T.description: Allow the behavior to transmit this object; otherwise its value may change locally without a telegram.

R.description: Answer a GroupValueRead received on any of the object's addresses, on its sending address; enabled by default for status ports.

U.description: Apply a received GroupValueResponse as an update; enabled by default for display ports.

C.description: Communication (enabled by default): when false, the object neither sends nor handles any message.

I.description: Read on initialisation: when the device starts again after a bus voltage failure, it reads the object's value on its sending address.

priority.description: Transmission priority of the frames the object sends (low by default); system priority is reserved for management.

button.description: Button drawn on the device card; use press or a short/long pair.

id.description: ID unique among buttons and inputs on this device.

label.description: Label on the button; for example “Key 2 · Down” displays Key 2 prominently.

oneOf.description: I: on
O: off
I/O: toggle
▲: up
▼: down
▲▼: shutter on one key
☰: scene
◉: presence
◷: clock
☼+: brighten
☼−: dim

icon.description: Icon inferred from the action when omitted.

press.description: Action taken immediately on press; cannot be combined with short/long.

object.description: ID of an object on the same device (input port, with a group address).

value.description: Value within the object's DPT range, or “toggle” to invert a one-bit local object value.

short.description: Action on release before the long-press threshold.

object.description: ID of an object on the same device (input port, with a group address).

value.description: Value within the object's DPT range, or “toggle” to invert a one-bit local object value.

long.description: Action after the long-press threshold (0.5 s by default).

object.description: ID of an object on the same device (input port, with a group address).

value.description: Value within the object's DPT range, or “toggle” to invert a one-bit local object value.

release.description: Action on release after a long press, such as stopping DPT 3.007 dimming.

object.description: ID of an object on the same device (input port, with a group address).

value.description: Value within the object's DPT range, or “toggle” to invert a one-bit local object value.

led.description: Object whose value lights the button indicator.

input.description: Numeric input drawn on the device card.

id.description: ID unique among buttons and inputs on this device.

type.description: The only input type is number.

object.description: Input object with a group address; written and transmitted on submission.

min.description: Minimum value; defaults to the DPT minimum.

max.description: Maximum value; defaults to the DPT maximum.

room.description: Room thermal model: heat loss toward outside temperature plus equipment output; an open window increases loss.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the ID.

temperatureC.description: Initial indoor temperature in °C; defaults to 20.

timeConstantMs.description: Thermal loss time constant in simulated milliseconds; defaults to 300,000 ms.

equipment.description: Non-KNX equipment connected to a channel output.

type.description: Equipment type: lamp, shutter, or a registered extension type.

name.description: Name of the load, such as “Ceiling light”; shown in the diagram and the designer.

view.description: View type; defaults to the equipment type, such as an extension's ledStrip view.

room.description: Heated or cooled room ID from rooms; required for a radiator.

parameters.description: Equipment parameters, such as a shutter's actualTravelTimeMs.

initialState.description: Initial physical state, such as a shutter's positionPct.

powerW.title: Rated power
powerW.description: Electrical power (W) drawn while the lamp is on; used by metering actuators. Any switched load can be represented with a matching power.

actualTravelTimeMs.title: Actual travel time
actualTravelTimeMs.description: Actual time for one complete travel (ms): downwards, and upwards unless actualTravelTimeUpMs is set.

actualTravelTimeUpMs.title: Actual travel time up
actualTravelTimeUpMs.description: Actual time for one complete upward travel (ms), when it differs from the downward time.

slatTravelMs.title: Actual slat rotation time
slatTravelMs.description: Venetian blind: time for the slats to turn from open to closed (ms). The motor first turns the slats, then moves the blind. 0 describes a roller shutter without slats.

wiringReversed.title: Motor wired in reverse
wiringReversed.description: Physical wiring with the up and down wires swapped: the motor turns opposite to the command. The actuator's “Inverted wiring” parameter compensates it.

powerW.title: Rated power
powerW.description: Electrical power (W) at full level; the drawn power is proportional to the level.

ballasts.title: Number of ballasts
ballasts.description: Number of ballasts (luminaires) in the group.

firstAddress.title: First short address
firstAddress.description: Short DALI address of the first ballast; subsequent ballasts use consecutive addresses.

failed.title: Faulty ballasts
failed.description: Number of ballasts initially reporting a lamp or ballast fault.

openingTimeMs.title: Valve travel time
openingTimeMs.description: Time for the valve to open fully (ms). Real valves take about 3 minutes; this is compressed like room time and should be short relative to the PWM period.

normallyOpen.title: Valve open when de-energised
normallyOpen.description: Normally open valve: applying power closes it.

powerK.title: Heating effect (K)
powerK.description: Temperature difference (K) from outdoors that this radiator can maintain alone with the valve fully open.

emitter.title: Emitter
emitter.description: heating warms the room; cooling cools it, for example a fan coil with condensate drainage. Humidity and condensation are not modeled.

powerW.title: Rated power
powerW.description: Electrical power (W) at full speed; the drawn power is proportional to the speed.

powerW.title: Rated power
powerW.description: Electrical power (W) drawn while the appliance is powered.

powerW.title: Element power
powerW.description: Electrical power (W) of the element while it heats.

setpointC.title: Thermostat setpoint
setpointC.description: Temperature (°C) at which the thermostat of the element cuts the heating.

hysteresisK.title: Thermostat hysteresis
hysteresisK.description: The element heats again once the water is this much below the setpoint (K).

lossKPerH.title: Standing losses
lossKPerH.description: Cooling of the water without draw-off (K per hour).

timeScale.title: Time acceleration
timeScale.description: The water heats and cools this many times faster than real time, so that a heating cycle of hours lasts minutes (as energy metering).

drawL.title: Draw-off
drawL.description: Volume of hot water drawn off by a click on the cylinder (litres), replaced by cold water at 10 °C.

mode.title: Operating mode
mode.description: Heating warms the room; cooling cools it (reversible unit).

electricPowerW.title: Electrical power
electricPowerW.description: Electrical power (W) drawn while the compressor runs.

cop.title: Coefficient of performance
cop.description: Heat delivered divided by the electrical power drawn (shown on the unit; the room model uses powerK).

powerK.title: Heating effect (K)
powerK.description: Temperature difference (K) from outdoors that the unit can maintain alone while it runs.

minOffMs.title: Minimum off time
minOffMs.description: Time the compressor stays off after a stop before it may start again (anti short-cycle); real units wait a few minutes, compressed here like room time.

ringLimitMs.title: Ringing time limit
ringLimitMs.description: The sounder stops after this time even if still powered; the flash light stays on (0: no limit). Outdoor sounders are often limited to 3 minutes.

channel.description: Actuator output channel; declare hardware channels even when unused.

id.description: ID unique within the device and referenced by its communication objects.

label.description: Label of the channel: a load label such as L1 (“unused” for an unconnected output), or the name of an input.

keyLabel.description: Text written on the push-button wired to a contact input (push-button interface), drawn on its key; by default the key shows the label.

keyContact.description: Contact of the push-button wired to a contact input: normally open (closes when pressed, default) or normally closed.

parameters.description: Behavior-specific channel parameters, such as timer or travel time.

initialState.description: Initial application state of the channel.

anyOf.description: Several loads wired in parallel on the output; they all receive its commands.

equipment.description: Connected equipment: one load, a list of loads switched together, or null for a free output without a drawn load.

scenes.description: Scene presets: scene number 1–64 maps to a relay state or shutter position.

device.description: KNX device with an individual address, objects, buttons, inputs, and channels.

name.description: Name shown on the device card; defaults to the ID.

address.description: Individual address in area.line.device form; its line must be declared.

kind.description: Type of device, as a free description (buttonInterface, switchActuator, display…). Only a behavior that documents a value gives it an effect: display/v1 draws "supervisor" as a supervision software.

behavior.description: Versioned ID of the device's registered behavior.

parameters.description: Device parameters defined by its behavior.

medium.description: Communication medium: TP by default, or IP on the topology.ip network (a supervisor on the IP network writes "IP").

room.description: Assigned room ID; thermostats, window contacts, and temperature sensors observe that room.

inFilterTables.description: false: do not include this virtual device in coupler filter tables.

downstream.description: Device on the downstream segment of a line extension.

description.description: Explanation shown when selecting the device card.

meterIntervalMs.title: Metering send interval
meterIntervalMs.description: Cyclic sending of power and energy values (ms), for channels with metering objects.

powerSendDeltaW.title: Power send threshold
powerSendDeltaW.description: Send a power value when it changes by at least this many watts.

energyTimeScale.title: Energy time scale
energyTimeScale.description: Energy counting speed: 60 counts one simulated second as one minute, so that the counter moves visibly; 1 counts real time.

powerLimitW.title: Total power limit
powerLimitW.description: Total power (W) of the actuator outputs at which the powerLimit object is set, for load shedding (0 disables it).

sheddingTimeMs.title: Minimum shedding time
sheddingTimeMs.description: A shed output is switched on again after this time, if its command still requests it; it is shed again if the limit is still exceeded.

powerLimitHysteresisW.title: Power limit hysteresis
powerLimitHysteresisW.description: The powerLimit object is reset below limit − hysteresis (W).

timerMs.title: Timer
timerMs.description: Timer duration (ms); null disables the timer.

timerRetrigger.title: Timer retriggering
timerRetrigger.description: When 1 is received during a timer: restart begins a full period, none ignores it, and add extends the period (up to five times).

timerWarningMs.title: Switch-off warning
timerWarningMs.description: Time before the timer ends when the output briefly opens for one second as a warning (0 disables the warning).

timerOffAllowed.title: Early switch-off by 0
timerOffAllowed.description: Allow a 0 write to switch off before the timer ends; otherwise ignore it.

loadShedding.title: Shed on power limit
loadShedding.description: Switch this output off while the total power limit of the actuator is exceeded (load shedding).

relayMode.title: Relay operating mode
relayMode.description: normallyOpen closes the contact when the channel is on; normallyClosed closes it when the channel is off, so the load is powered while the switching state is 0. Status feedback reports the switching state, not the contact.

onDelayMs.title: Switch-on delay
onDelayMs.description: Delay between a 1 on the switching object and switching on (0: at once). A 0 received meanwhile cancels it; scenes, forcing, and the lock act at once.

offDelayMs.title: Switch-off delay
offDelayMs.description: Delay between a 0 on the switching object and switching off (0: at once). A 1 received meanwhile cancels it.

lockStart.title: When locked
lockStart.description: State of the output when the lock object receives 1; while locked, commands are stored without effect. Forcing has priority over the lock.

afterLock.title: End of lock
afterLock.description: State when the lock object receives 0: follow the latest command received while locked, restore the state before the lock, keep the current state, switch on, switch off, or invert.

logicOperation.title: Logic operation
logicOperation.description: Combination of the switching command with the logic object (for example an enable from a presence detector). Until the logic object receives a value, the command acts alone.

sceneLearning.title: Scene storing
sceneLearning.description: A scene control telegram with the learn bit (DPT 18.001) stores the current state of the output as the scene; it replaces the configured preset until the simulation restarts.

busFailure.title: On bus voltage failure
busFailure.description: State of the output when the bus voltage fails; the relay is then left as it is until the voltage returns.

busRecovery.title: On bus voltage recovery
busRecovery.description: State of the output when the bus voltage returns; the status feedback is then sent.

blinkMs.title: Blinking period on intrusion
blinkMs.description: Time the contact stays closed, then open, while the intrusion alarm makes the output blink; mind the switching life of the relay.

afterAlarm.title: End of the alarms
afterAlarm.description: State when the last alarm (fire, intrusion) ends: follow the latest command received during the alarm, restore the state before it, keep it on, switch on, or switch off.

afterForcing.title: End of forcing
afterForcing.description: State after a priority override ends: follow the latest command received during the override, restore the previous state, keep the forced state, switch on, switch off, or invert the forced state.

on.title: On at start
on.description: Switching state of the channel when the simulation starts.

estimatedTravelTimeMs.title: Configured travel time
estimatedTravelTimeMs.description: Travel time configured in the actuator (ms): downwards, and upwards unless estimatedTravelTimeUpMs is set.

estimatedTravelTimeUpMs.title: Configured travel time up
estimatedTravelTimeUpMs.description: Upward travel time configured in the actuator (ms), when it differs from the downward time; many actuators take separate times because a shutter rises more slowly than it falls.

startDelayMs.title: Start delay
startDelayMs.description: Delay before starting or reversing motion (ms).

slatTravelMs.title: Configured slat rotation time
slatTravelMs.description: Venetian blind: time configured for the slats to turn from open to closed (ms). A movement first turns the slats; a short press at rest turns them by slatStepPct. 0 for a roller shutter without slats.

slatStepPct.title: Slat step
slatStepPct.description: Slat angle change for a short press at rest (%).

stepPct.title: Stop/step increment
stepPct.description: Position step for a stop/step command received at rest by a shutter without slats (%). 0 (default): no movement, as in the KNX stop/step function, where the step turns slats; some actuators move a roller shutter by this amount instead.

endSupplementPct.title: End-of-travel supplement
endSupplementPct.description: Extra travel time toward 0% or 100%, as a percentage of full travel. The motor runs even if the estimate is already at the limit; the end stop recalibrates the estimate (often 5–10% on a real actuator).

invertOutput.title: Inverted wiring
invertOutput.description: Invert the up and down outputs to compensate a motor wired in reverse (shutter parameter wiringReversed). Without such wiring, enabling it makes the shutter move opposite to the commands.

sceneLearning.title: Scene storing
sceneLearning.description: A scene control telegram with the learn bit (DPT 18.001) stores the current estimated position as the scene; it replaces the configured preset until the simulation restarts.

windReaction.title: On wind alarm
windReaction.description: Movement when the wind alarm starts; commands are then ignored until it ends.

rainReaction.title: On rain alarm
rainReaction.description: Movement when the rain alarm starts (an awning or a blind is usually raised).

frostReaction.title: On frost alarm
frostReaction.description: Movement when the frost alarm starts; a frozen shutter is usually left where it is.

alarmPriority.title: Priority of the weather alarms
alarmPriority.description: Order of the weather alarms when several are active: the first one active applies.

safetyPriority.title: Priority of the safety functions
safetyPriority.description: Order of the weather alarms, the lock, and forcing when several are active: the first one active holds the output, and commands are ignored.

alarmMonitoringMs.title: Monitoring of the alarm objects
alarmMonitoringMs.description: Weather sensors send their alarm cyclically: without a telegram on an alarm object within this time, the alarm is assumed (0: no monitoring).

afterAlarm.title: After the weather alarms
afterAlarm.description: Movement when the last weather alarm ends.

afterForcing.title: End of forcing
afterForcing.description: Movement when the forcing ends (0 or 1 on the forcing object).

preset1Pct.title: Stored position 1
preset1Pct.description: Position recalled by 0 on the object of positions 1/2.

preset2Pct.title: Stored position 2
preset2Pct.description: Position recalled by 1 on the object of positions 1/2.

preset3Pct.title: Stored position 3
preset3Pct.description: Position recalled by 0 on the object of positions 3/4.

preset4Pct.title: Stored position 4
preset4Pct.description: Position recalled by 1 on the object of positions 3/4.

presetStoring.title: Storing of the positions
presetStoring.description: The store objects replace a stored position with the current estimated position, until the simulation restarts.

lockStart.title: When locked
lockStart.description: Movement when the lock object receives 1; the wind alarm keeps priority.

lockPositionPct.title: Position when locked
lockPositionPct.description: Position reached when the lock starts, with “Position”.

afterLock.title: When unlocked
afterLock.description: Movement when the lock object receives 0.

busFailure.title: On bus voltage failure
busFailure.description: Motor when the bus voltage fails: stopped, or driven toward an end position until the voltage returns; the estimated position follows the time elapsed.

busRecovery.title: On bus voltage recovery
busRecovery.description: Movement when the bus voltage returns; the estimated position is sent in any case.

busRecoveryPositionPct.title: Position on bus recovery
busRecoveryPositionPct.description: Position reached on bus recovery, with “Position”.

estimatedPositionPct.title: Estimated position at start
estimatedPositionPct.description: Position the actuator assumes at start (0 = fully open, 100 = fully closed); the connected shutter starts at its own position.

estimatedSlatPct.title: Estimated slat angle at start
estimatedSlatPct.description: Slat angle the actuator assumes at start (venetian blinds).

oneOf.description: Up/down: 0 raises toward 0 %, 1 lowers toward 100 %.
Stop when moving; otherwise one step of stepPct (0 up, 1 down).
Target position in percent.
Estimated position, sent after stopping.
scene number (17.001), or scene control (18.001) whose learn bit stores the current position

estimated slat angle, sent after stopping

3 forces down, 2 forces up; 0 or 1 ends the forcing (afterForcing). By default, weather alarms and the lock keep priority (safetyPriority).
0 moves to the stored position 1, 1 to the stored position 2
0 moves to the stored position 3, 1 to the stored position 4
0 stores the current position as position 1, 1 as position 2
0 stores the current position as position 3, 1 as position 4
1 when the shutter is estimated at the top (0 %), sent on change
1 when the shutter is estimated at the bottom (100 %), sent on change

Value received and kept, as shown by a visualization.

lockStart.title: When locked
lockStart.description: Telegram when the lock object receives 1: none (the hold time runs out as usual), 0 at once, or 1 kept while locked. While locked, detections are ignored.

lockEnd.title: When unlocked
lockEnd.description: Telegram when the lock object receives 0: none, 0, or 1 followed by the hold time.

slave.title: Slave detector
slave.description: Sends 1 on each detection, for the slaveTrigger object of a master detector of the same room; the master keeps the hold time, the brightness threshold, and the final 0.

holdMs.title: Hold time
holdMs.description: Time with no detected presence before sending 0 (ms); restarted on each detection.

retrigger.title: Hold time restarted by a detection
retrigger.description: Each activation restarts the timer; otherwise it runs from the first activation.

sendOnEnd.title: Send 0 at the end
sendOnEnd.description: Send 0 when the timer expires; otherwise the detector sends only 1 and the actuator handles switch-off.

brightnessThresholdLux.title: Switch-on brightness threshold
brightnessThresholdLux.description: A detection switches on only while the entered brightness is below this value (lx); an active presence is still extended. 0 disables the threshold.

oneOf.description: output object: 1 on detection, 0 when the timer expires
1 locks the detector: its detections (and those of its slaves) are ignored; 0 unlocks it
1 sent by a slave detector of the same room: counts as a detection (master/slave operation)
measured brightness (lx), entered by the reader and sent; there is no light model

groupAddresses.title: Group addresses assigned to the interface
groupAddresses.description: Group addresses assigned to this interface in the project, separated by spaces or commas. Coupler filter tables include them, so telegrams on these addresses cross couplers to and from the interface. Without them, a coupler filters an address that is not used on the interface side.

onLevel.title: Switch-on value
onLevel.description: Level when switched on: fixed uses onLevelPct; last restores the level before switch-off.

onLevelPct.title: Switch-on level
onLevelPct.description: Level reached when a value of 1 is received (fixed mode).

dimTimeMs.title: Dimming time
dimTimeMs.description: Time for a 0–100% relative dimming transition (DPT 3.007); smaller steps take less time.

switchFadeMs.title: Fade on switching
switchFadeMs.description: Transition time when switching on or off (0 means immediate).

sceneLearning.title: Scene storing
sceneLearning.description: A scene control telegram with the learn bit (DPT 18.001) stores the current level as the scene; it replaces the configured preset until the simulation restarts.

valueFadeMs.title: Fade on value
valueFadeMs.description: Transition time to a received value (5.001) or scene preset.

maxLevelPct.title: Maximum level
maxLevelPct.description: Upper limit for relative dimming and received values.

dimSwitchesOn.title: Switch on by dimming
dimSwitchesOn.description: An increase command turns on a channel that is off.

dimSwitchesOff.title: Switch off by dimming
dimSwitchesOff.description: A decrease command may dim to off; otherwise it stops at the minimum level.

valueSwitchesOn.title: Switch on by brightness value
valueSwitchesOn.description: A brightness value above 0 turns on a channel that is off; otherwise the value is ignored while the channel is off.

valueSwitchesOff.title: Switch off by brightness value
valueSwitchesOff.description: A brightness value of 0 turns the channel off; otherwise the channel dims to its minimum level.

statusDelayMs.title: Status feedback delay
statusDelayMs.description: Delay before sending status feedback (ms), after a transition completes.

busFailure.title: On bus voltage failure
busFailure.description: Level of the channel when the bus voltage fails; it is then kept until the voltage returns.

busFailureLevelPct.title: Level on bus voltage failure
busFailureLevelPct.description: Level set when the bus voltage fails, with “Fixed level”.

busRecovery.title: On bus voltage recovery
busRecovery.description: Level of the channel when the bus voltage returns (on: the switch-on level); the status feedback is then sent.

minColourK.title: Warmest colour temperature
minColourK.description: Lowest colour temperature (K) of a tunable white channel; lower requests are limited to it.

maxColourK.title: Coldest colour temperature
maxColourK.description: Highest colour temperature (K) of a tunable white channel; higher requests are limited to it.

presenceType.title: Presence input
presenceType.description: detector: comfort while the presence object is 1; button: each 1 extends the comfort mode for comfortExtensionMs.

comfortExtensionMs.title: Comfort extension
comfortExtensionMs.description: Duration of the comfort mode started by the presence button (2 h by default).

controlType.title: Control type
controlType.description: pi uses proportional-integral control with a continuous value (5.001) or PWM (1 bit); twoPoint uses on/off control with hysteresis.

comfortC.title: Base setpoint
comfortC.description: Initial heating comfort setpoint (°C); the baseSetpoint object can replace it.

standbyShiftK.title: Standby setback
standbyShiftK.description: Standby setpoint offset (K): lower for heating, higher for cooling.

economyShiftK.title: Economy setback
economyShiftK.description: Economy or night setpoint offset (K): lower for heating, higher for cooling.

deadZoneK.title: Dead zone
deadZoneK.description: Difference between heating and cooling comfort setpoints (K), for example 21 °C and 24 °C.

minSetpointC.title: Minimum setpoint
minSetpointC.description: Lowest base setpoint accepted (°C); lower received or entered values are raised to it.

maxSetpointC.title: Maximum setpoint
maxSetpointC.description: Highest base setpoint accepted (°C); higher received or entered values are lowered to it.

hysteresisK.title: Hysteresis
hysteresisK.description: Two-point control switches on again when temperature differs from the setpoint by this amount (K).

proportionalBandK.title: Proportional band
proportionalBandK.description: Temperature difference (K) that produces 100% output from the proportional term.

integralTimeMs.title: Integral time
integralTimeMs.description: PI integral time: a constant error doubles the proportional response after this duration (0 selects P control). Real installations use 60–240 minutes; the default follows compressed simulated room time.

pwmCycleMs.title: PWM cycle time
pwmCycleMs.description: PWM cycle period for a 1-bit control object (real installations typically use 10–20 minutes).

controlPeriodMs.title: Calculation period
controlPeriodMs.description: Interval at which the controller recalculates its control value from the measured temperature.

valueSendDeltaPct.title: Send on change
valueSendDeltaPct.description: Send the control value when it changes by at least this many percentage points.

sensorFaultValuePct.title: Control value on sensor fault
sensorFaultValuePct.description: Control value sent when no temperature is usable (external temperature too old, no room sensor), until a temperature comes back.

externalTempTimeoutMs.title: External temperature timeout
externalTempTimeoutMs.description: If no externalTemp value arrives within this time, control uses the internal sensor again until a new value arrives (0 disables monitoring).

valueCyclicMs.title: Cyclic sending of control value
valueCyclicMs.description: Periodically resend the control value (0 disables it); needed when the actuator monitors incoming values.

temperatureSendDeltaK.title: Temperature send threshold
temperatureSendDeltaK.description: Send measured temperature when it changes by at least this amount (K).

temperatureCyclicMs.title: Cyclic sending of temperature
temperatureCyclicMs.description: Also send the measured temperature at this interval, even without change; 0 disables cyclic sending.

oneOf.description: Measured temperature (9.001), sent on change.
1 when no temperature is usable (external temperature too old and no room sensor); 0 when one comes back
replaces the internal sensor after a value is received

valveType.title: Valve direction of action
valveType.description: normallyClosed: valve closed without power (common); normallyOpen: valve open without power, so the output is inverted.

cycleMs.title: PWM cycle time
cycleMs.description: PWM period for a continuous control value: powered time equals value × period (real installations typically use 10–20 minutes).

monitoringMs.title: Control value monitoring
monitoringMs.description: If no control value arrives within this time, enter fallback mode and report a fault (0 disables monitoring).

emergencyPct.title: Emergency control value
emergencyPct.description: Control value applied in fallback mode.

oneOf.description: Continuous control value of the valve (5.001), applied by pulse-width modulation over cycleMs.
two-point or thermostat PWM control
Control value applied to the valve (5.001).
missing control value: fallback program

contactType.title: Contact type
contactType.description: Physical contact: a normally open contact is closed while the window is closed; a normally closed contact is open while the window is closed.

invert.title: Invert input
invert.description: Interpret the electrical input for a normally closed contact. The transmitted value always follows the DPT (1.019: 1 = open; 1.009: 1 = closed).

sendOnStart.title: Send on start
sendOnStart.description: Send contact state when the simulation starts, as after bus power returns, so a thermostat can detect an already open window.

startDelayMs.title: Start-up send delay
startDelayMs.description: Delay after the simulation starts before the contact state is sent.

oneOf.description: 1.019 / 1.001: 1 means open; 1.009: 1 means closed

sendDeltaK.title: Send on change
sendDeltaK.description: Temperature change (K) that triggers a transmission.

oneOf.description: Room temperature (9.001).

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Logic function applied to the inputs; an input with no value yet counts as 0.

activeFrom.title: Time window from
activeFrom.description: Start of a daily time window (HH:MM). With activeTo and a time object, the output is 1 only inside the window; the window may cross midnight.

activeTo.title: Time window to
activeTo.description: End of the daily time window (HH:MM), excluded.

invertOutput.title: Invert the result
invertOutput.description: Send the inverse of the operation: NAND, NOR, or XNOR. Outside a time window, the output stays 0.

invertInput1.title: Invert input 1
invertInput1.description: Invert the value of the logic input object number 1, in the order of the objects.

invertInput2.title: Invert input 2
invertInput2.description: Invert the value of the logic input object number 2, in the order of the objects.

invertInput3.title: Invert input 3
invertInput3.description: Invert the value of the logic input object number 3, in the order of the objects.

invertInput4.title: Invert input 4
invertInput4.description: Invert the value of the logic input object number 4, in the order of the objects.

invertInput5.title: Invert input 5
invertInput5.description: Invert the value of the logic input object number 5, in the order of the objects.

invertInput6.title: Invert input 6
invertInput6.description: Invert the value of the logic input object number 6, in the order of the objects.

invertInput7.title: Invert input 7
invertInput7.description: Invert the value of the logic input object number 7, in the order of the objects.

invertInput8.title: Invert input 8
invertInput8.description: Invert the value of the logic input object number 8, in the order of the objects.

enableAtStart.title: Enable at start
enableAtStart.description: State of the output before the enable object receives a first telegram.

enablePolarity.title: Polarity of the enable object
enablePolarity.description: Value of the enable object that blocks the output.

sendOnChangeOnly.title: Send on change only
sendOnChangeOnly.description: Send the result only when it differs from the last transmitted value.

oneOf.description: one-bit input of the logic function
0 blocks the output; 1 enables it again and sends the current result
time received from a clock master, used by the time window
result of the logic function

windThreshold.title: Wind alarm threshold
windThreshold.description: Wind speed (m/s) at which the wind alarm is set.

windHysteresis.title: Wind alarm hysteresis
windHysteresis.description: The alarm is reset when the wind speed falls below threshold − hysteresis (m/s).

brightnessThreshold.title: Sun protection threshold
brightnessThreshold.description: Brightness (lux) at which sun protection is requested.

frostThresholdC.title: Frost alarm threshold
frostThresholdC.description: Outdoor temperature (°C) at or below which the frost alarm is set.

frostHysteresisK.title: Frost alarm hysteresis
frostHysteresisK.description: The frost alarm is reset once the temperature rises above threshold + hysteresis (K).

rainOnDelayMs.title: Delay of the rain alarm
rainOnDelayMs.description: Rain must last this long before the rain alarm is set, so that a short shower is not reported.

rainOffDelayMs.title: Delay of the end of rain
rainOffDelayMs.description: The rain alarm is reset this long after the rain stops, so that a short break is not reported.

alarmCyclicMs.title: Cyclic sending of the alarms
alarmCyclicMs.description: Period at which the wind, rain, and frost alarms are sent again, for actuators that monitor them (0: on change only).

setsRoomOutdoorTemperature.title: Outdoor temperature applies to the rooms
setsRoomOutdoorTemperature.description: An entered outdoor temperature also becomes the outdoor temperature of every room in the thermal model, so that the building reacts to it.

brightnessHysteresis.title: Sun protection hysteresis
brightnessHysteresis.description: The request is reset when brightness falls below threshold − hysteresis (lux).

oneOf.description: measured wind speed, sent when entered: m/s with 9.005, km/h with 9.028 (thresholds stay in m/s)
measured brightness (lux), sent when entered
measured outdoor temperature (°C), sent when entered

co2AlarmPpm.title: CO₂ alarm threshold
co2AlarmPpm.description: CO₂ concentration (ppm) at which the CO₂ alarm is set.

co2AlarmHysteresisPpm.title: CO₂ alarm hysteresis
co2AlarmHysteresisPpm.description: The CO₂ alarm is reset below threshold − hysteresis (ppm).

humidityAlarmPct.title: Humidity alarm threshold
humidityAlarmPct.description: Relative humidity (%) at which the humidity alarm is set.

humidityAlarmHysteresisPct.title: Humidity alarm hysteresis
humidityAlarmHysteresisPct.description: The humidity alarm is reset below threshold − hysteresis (%).

step1Ppm.title: Threshold step 0 ↔ 1
step1Ppm.description: CO₂ concentration (ppm) between ventilation steps 0 and 1.

step2Ppm.title: Threshold step 1 ↔ 2
step2Ppm.description: CO₂ concentration (ppm) between ventilation steps 1 and 2.

step3Ppm.title: Threshold step 2 ↔ 3
step3Ppm.description: CO₂ concentration (ppm) between ventilation steps 2 and 3.

stepHysteresisPpm.title: Step hysteresis
stepHysteresisPpm.description: A step changes only above threshold + hysteresis or below threshold − hysteresis (ppm).

step0Pct.title: Control value step 0
step0Pct.description: Ventilation control value (%) sent in step 0.

step1Pct.title: Control value step 1
step1Pct.description: Ventilation control value (%) sent in step 1.

step2Pct.title: Control value step 2
step2Pct.description: Ventilation control value (%) sent in step 2.

step3Pct.title: Control value step 3
step3Pct.description: Ventilation control value (%) sent in step 3.

minStepTimeMs.title: Minimum time per step
minStepTimeMs.description: A step is kept at least this long before the next change (0 disables it).

oneOf.description: measured temperature (°C), sent when entered
measured relative humidity (%), sent when entered: 2-byte float with 9.007, one byte with 5.001

sendPeriodMin.title: Send period
sendPeriodMin.description: Clock minutes between two broadcasts, at second 30 of the minute (10 minutes is the standard heartbeat of a KNX system clock); 0 sends only at start and after the clock is set.

sendOnStart.title: Send on start
sendOnStart.description: Send time and date shortly after the simulation starts.

startDelayMs.title: Start-up send delay
startDelayMs.description: Delay after the simulation starts before time and date are sent.

oneOf.description: day of week and time of the simulated clock
date of the simulated clock

program.title: Weekly program
program.description: Switching points separated by semicolons: days, time, and value, for example “Mon-Fri 07:00 = 1; Sat,Sun 09:00 = 1; Daily 22:30 = 0”. Days: Mon … Sun, ranges (Mon-Fri), lists (Sat,Sun), or Daily.

overrideDurationMin.title: Duration of the timed override
overrideDurationMin.description: Clock minutes during which a value received on the timed override object holds (15 min to 72 h).

sendOnStart.title: Send current state on start
sendOnStart.description: At start, and after the clock is set, send the value of the most recent switching point.

oneOf.description: object that receives the programmed values

Value sent at once on the output, held for overrideDurationMin clock minutes; the program value then applies
1 suspends the program (switching points ignored); 0 resumes it and sends its current value

system.title: Other system
system.description: Name of the system on the other side of the gateway, shown on the device card and in the event log, such as Modbus, BACnet, or M-Bus.

oneOf.description: value read in the other system (temperature, state, meter…), sent on KNX when entered
value received from KNX and forwarded to the other system (mode, setpoint, boost…)

meterIntervalMs.title: Metering send interval
meterIntervalMs.description: Cyclic sending of power and energy values (ms).

powerSendDeltaW.title: Power send threshold
powerSendDeltaW.description: Send a power value when it changes by at least this many watts.

energyTimeScale.title: Energy time scale
energyTimeScale.description: Energy counting speed: 60 counts one simulated second as one minute, so that the counter moves visibly; 1 counts real time.

powerW.title: Measured power at start
powerW.description: Power (W) drawn by the circuit when the simulation starts; a numeric input on the power object changes it.

energyWh.title: Meter index at start
energyWh.description: Energy (Wh) already counted when the simulation starts.

oneOf.description: power measured on the circuit: W with 14.056, kW with 9.024; a numeric input on this object enters the measured power
energy counted on the circuit, sent cyclically: Wh with 13.010, kWh with 13.013
sum of the measured circuits: W with 14.056, kW with 9.024

function.title: Function
function.description: What the input controls; the group objects and settings depend on it.

longPressMs.title: Long press from
longPressMs.description: A press held at least this long is a long press.

switchLongPress.title: Short and long presses
switchLongPress.description: Tell short and long presses apart, with an action for each; otherwise one action when the key is pressed and one when it is released.

onPress.title: On press
onPress.description: Switching telegram when the contact closes.

onRelease.title: On release
onRelease.description: Switching telegram when the contact opens.

onShort.title: Short press
onShort.description: Switching telegram after a short press, when the key is released.

onLong.title: Long press
onLong.description: Switching telegram when the long-press time is reached.

dimMode.title: Operation (dimming)
dimMode.description: One key switches with a short press and dims with a long press, brighter when the light is off and otherwise the other way than last time; two keys share the work, one brighter and one darker. Releasing the key stops dimming.

dimStep.title: Dimming step
dimStep.description: Step code of the relative dimming telegram (DPT 3.007); 100 % dims until the key is released.

blindMode.title: Operation (blind)
blindMode.description: A long press moves the blind and a short press stops it or steps; with one key the direction changes at each movement, and follows the up/down object when it receives a telegram.

stopOnRelease.title: Stop on release
stopOnRelease.description: Releasing the key after a long press stops the blind (hold to move); otherwise the blind runs to its end position unless a short press stops it.

shortValue.title: Value on short press
shortValue.description: Value sent by a short press (by any press when there is no long-press value), in the unit of the object's DPT.

longValue.title: Value on long press
longValue.description: Value sent by a long press; null sends the short-press value at once.

sceneNumber.title: Scene number
sceneNumber.description: Scene recalled by a short press.

sceneStore.title: Store by long press
sceneStore.description: A long press asks the actuators to store their current state as the scene (DPT 18.001, learn bit); a short press recalls it.

lockStart.title: When locked
lockStart.description: Switching telegram sent when the lock object receives 1.

lockEnd.title: When unlocked
lockEnd.description: Switching telegram sent when the lock object receives 0.

blindLockStart.title: When locked (blind)
blindLockStart.description: Movement sent when the lock object receives 1.

blindLockEnd.title: When unlocked (blind)
blindLockEnd.description: Movement sent when the lock object receives 0.

busRecovery.title: On bus voltage recovery
busRecovery.description: Switching telegram sent when the bus voltage returns after a failure.

blindBusRecovery.title: On bus voltage recovery (blind)
blindBusRecovery.description: Movement sent when the bus voltage returns after a failure.

busRecoveryDelayMs.title: Recovery delay
busRecoveryDelayMs.description: Delay before the bus recovery reaction, so that the devices of a line do not all send at once.

cyclicMs.title: Cyclic sending
cyclicMs.description: Send the switching object again at this interval, for example for a device that monitors it.

cyclicWhen.title: Cyclic sending of
cyclicWhen.description: Which value of the switching object is sent cyclically.

actuatedContact.title: Input when actuated
actuatedContact.description: State of the input contact when the push-button is actuated: closed for a normally open push-button, open for a normally closed one.

ledShown.title: LED on the key
ledShown.description: The key has an LED: it shows the LED object when it is enabled, otherwise the switching object of a switching or dimming input.

ledInverted.title: LED lit for 0
ledInverted.description: The LED is lit while its object is 0 and off while it is 1.

blind movement; with W set, a one-key input takes the direction of the last movement received
